pricing.billingNote: Free open web access to transcribed and scanned vintage radio scripts.
pricing.freeTierNote: Full HTML/text access to ~1,200+ original broadcast scripts and series logs.

provenance.primaryMasterSource: Original studio mimeographed production scripts with cue numbers, sound effects (SFX), and music cues
provenance.airdateMethodology: Transcribed directly from studio script cover pages (Network, Date, Rehearsal/Broadcast timings)
provenance.castAttributionMethod: Explicit character-to-actor cast lists from studio production scripts

specNotes.studio_scripts: Hosts ~1,850 HTML studio script transcriptions, but only ~280 playable audio streams.

primary_source_verification.summary: Script cover pages preserve original network date stamps, studio call letters, and script draft dates.
primary_source_verification.evidenceQuote: "Transcribed directly from original network mimeograph scripts including broadcast date, sponsor, and agency headers."

cast_credit_accuracy.summary: Every line of dialogue is labeled by exact character name, often paired with the studio cast sheet.
cast_credit_accuracy.evidenceQuote: "Full dramatic dialogue broken down line-by-line by character name, SFX cue, and musical bridge."

vtt_transcripts.summary: Provides complete written studio scripts in clean HTML, but they are not time-aligned `.vtt` files synchronized to audio.
vtt_transcripts.evidenceQuote: "Complete HTML script text with stage directions, though not timestamped in WebVTT (.vtt) format."

master_provenance.summary: High provenance for script paper documents, but minimal audio holdings.
master_provenance.evidenceQuote: "Primary focus is textual preservation of original broadcast scripts rather than audio disc transfers."

serial_continuity.summary: Focuses primarily on prestige anthology series (*Suspense*, *Escape*, *CBS Workshop*) rather than daily serials.
serial_continuity.evidenceQuote: "Strongest coverage in standalone dramatic anthology scripts."

open_api_export.summary: Clean, crawlable HTML script pages, but no JSON API or `/llms.txt` index.
open_api_export.evidenceQuote: "Server-rendered HTML script pages easily readable by humans and crawlers, without a structured JSON API."

ad_free_playback.summary: 100% ad-free and free to read, but 85% of entries have no playable audio recording attached.
ad_free_playback.evidenceQuote: "Free textual script library; most entries do not include embedded audio streams."

dedup_integrity.summary: Clearly distinguishes original script drafts from later broadcast adaptations (e.g., *Suspense* vs. *Escape* script reuses).
dedup_integrity.evidenceQuote: "Notes script reuse across anthology series and variant production dates."

gotchas.title: Small Catalog Scope (~1,240 Scripts) & Minimal Audio
gotchas.detail: Covers roughly 1% of surviving OTR broadcasts and is designed for reading scripts rather than streaming audio.

gotchas.title: Rehearsal Script vs. As-Broadcast Audio Divergences
gotchas.detail: Mimeographed rehearsal scripts occasionally differ from the final live broadcast due to last-minute studio cuts or ad-libs.
